New York: In analysts note revealed to clients on 8 June, Argus maintained their “Buy” rating on Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) shares. They now have a $225 target price on the firm. Argus’s target would suggest a potential upside of 17.37 % from the company’s current stock price. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) Ratings Coverage
Among 35 analysts covering Apple ( NASDAQ:AAPL ), 18 have Buy rating, 0 Sell and 17 Hold. Therefore 51% are positive. Apple has $235 highest and $157 lowest target. $197.12’s average target is 2.83% above currents $191.7 stock price. Apple had 82 analyst reports since December 13, 2017 according to SRatingsIntel. RBC Capital Markets maintained the shares of AAPL in report on Monday, March 5 with “Buy” rating.
The stock decreased 0.91% or $1.76 during the last trading session, reaching $191.7. About 26.47 million shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 22.56% since June 8, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 9.99% the S&P500.
Analysts await Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) to report earnings on August, 7. They expect $2.19 earnings per share, up 31.14 % or $0.52 from last year’s $1.67 per share. AAPL’s profit will be $10.76 billion for 21.88 P/E if the $2.19 EPS becomes a reality. After $2.73 actual earnings per share reported by Apple Inc. for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts -19.78 % negative EPS growth.
Apple Inc. designs, manufactures, and markets mobile communication and media devices, personal computers, and portable digital music players to consumers, small and mid-sized businesses, and education, enterprise, and government clients worldwide. The company has market cap of $942.23 billion. The firm also sells related software, services, accessories, networking solutions, and third-party digital content and applications. It has a 18.54 P/E ratio. It offers iPhone, a line of smartphones; iPad, a line of multi-purpose tablets; and Mac, a line of desktop and portable personal computers.
